summary: More than most people, a need to be seen and to matter and deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking. Owned, you shine and lead without trying and you read people and care on instinct.
body: More than most people, a need to be seen and to matter and deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking. Owned, you shine and lead without trying and you read people and care on instinct. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness. Your outer direction and inner needs may not always move together. Part of you may want one thing, while another part needs something quieter or more emotionally familiar.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you read people and care on instinct.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need.
integration: Let identity and emotional needs cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you read people work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
